draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.67, the 243rd-best grade among 257 2024 draftees and 22nd of 24 at DT. He went 243rd overall, close to where his grade ranked. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 2 sacks in 2023, 17th of 24 DTs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 3 pro, currently with the New York Jets. 23 career games and 8 starts over 2 completed seasons, plus 4 so far in 2026. Still developing: 4 AV in 2025. Strengths in 2025: tackles for loss 8 (91st percentile), sacks 4.0 (84th percentile), qb hits 10 (82nd percentile). Weak spots: missed tackle rate 9.5% (25th percentile). Versus the typical Year-2 interior lineman who played: 11 pressures against a median of 3, above the norm.
